headline: Approved adding new voters to the checklist and removing voters who moved or are no longer eligible.
summary: Supervisors approved adding applicants to the voter checklist, 3-0. They also approved removing voters who moved, are no longer eligible, or were removed for other reasons, 3-0. Applications listed under New to NH and Transfer to my City/Town were approved by majority vote.
decisions: Approved adding voter registration applicants to the checklist, 3-0.
Approved removing voters from the checklist, 3-0.
Approved the voter registration applications listed under New to NH by majority vote of the Supervisors.
Approved the voter registration applications listed under Transfer to my City/Town by majority vote of the Supervisors.

decision_evidence.quote: Additions and Changes to the Checklist: The Supervisors of the Checklist considered applications for registrations by voters. Motion to accept by Supervisor Messina. Seconded by Supervisor Dombroski. Motion passed 3-0.

Voters Removed: The Supervisors of the Checklist considered removals of voters now registered in another town or city ward in New Hampshire, no longer eligible to vote in Derry, or removed for other reasons indicated. Motion to remove by Supervisor Dombroski. Seconded by Supervisor Messina. Motion passed 3-0.
New to NH ... Except where noted otherwise, the applications were approved by a majority vote of the Supervisors (Registrars).
Transfer to my City/Town ... Except where noted otherwise, the applications were approved by a majority vote of the Supervisors (Registrars).
